Contributing to crimlab

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Bug reports and pull requests are welcome at https://github.com/rootcoder007/crimlab/issues.

A bug report is most useful with a small reproducible example: the call, what it returned, and what you expected.

Before a pull request:

  • Computation belongs in the C++ core (src/core.cpp, declared in src/crimlab.h); the R functions check arguments and call it.
  • Every change comes with tests in tests/testthat. Coverage of R and C++ must not fall below the floor in .github/workflows/coverage.yml. Values from other packages are stored with the tests, never computed while they run: a script in dev/ref (one per test file) computes them and writes them, with the packages’ versions, to tests/testthat/ref. Rscript dev/ref/all.R DIR runs every script into DIR, and Rscript dev/ref/cmp.R tests/testthat/ref DIR compares the result with the stored values at the tolerances in tests/testthat/ref/tol.csv (a value a test reads needs a row there).
  • lintr::lint_package() must report no lints, and R CMD check --as-cran must pass with no errors or warnings.
  • Documentation is written with roxygen2; regenerate man/ and NAMESPACE with roxygen2::roxygenise().
  • A change to a result that proof() names needs the Lean proof in inst/lean to still build.

By contributing you agree that your contribution is licensed under the package licence (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception).
